reviews.author: sowji peddireddy
reviews.text:
I wholeheartedly recommend ASCAS clinic and Dr. Aishwarya ❤️, for her exceptional care, compassion, and expertise.

Mam’s professionalism, empathy, and unwavering support is invaluable. She took the time to explain and listen every silly doubts of mine, addressing our concerns and questions with kindness and patience. Her warmth and understanding made us feel safe and secured.
I was not at all confident on normal delivery but Dr Aishwarya and crew made it very easily and surprising I was in active labour for 6 hours and delivered  preterm baby which he is doing really fine, the effort care attention she put for the entire labour process is invaluable to me.

Dr. Ashwin’s support and dedicated staff Sharmila Anu and other person ensured we received excellent care and support From initial consultations to till date appointments, every interaction was seamless and reassuring.
Last but not the Least Dr Aishwarya is my lucky Dr and she remains the same❤️ forever grateful to her.

reviews.author: Aishwarya Aravind Bulbule
reviews.text:
I wholeheartedly recommend ASCAS clinic and Dr. Aishwarya Mam, for her exceptional care, compassion, and expertise transformed our challenging fertility journey into a successful, life-changing experience.

Mam’s professionalism, empathy, and unwavering support is invaluable. She took the time to explain every step, addressing our concerns and questions with kindness and patience. Her warmth and understanding made us feel seen and heard.

The clinic's compact facilities,along with Dr. Ashwin’s support and dedicated staff ensured we received excellent treatment. From initial consultations to till date appointments, every interaction was seamless and reassuring.

- Personalized treatment are planned and tailored to our needs.
- Dr. Aishwarya Mam is very Compassionate and supportive to even scan patients during non-clinic hours.

Thank you Dr. For your continuous support.

reviews.text:

Thankyou mam!!

reviews.author: Sri veni
reviews.text:
Ascas was suggested by my collegue...from the day 1 of my pregnancy till delivery ..Dr. Aishwarya have taken care of me mentally as well as physically. We are very thankful to Dr.Aishwarya and my recommendation for the couple who is expecting baby soon is ASCAS.
